thread:
alex: Quick weekly check-in for AcmeCorp caching+batching effectiveness. Pulled last 7 days (UTC). main takeaways in short: hit rate lower than expected, small batch sizes, morning latency spike, cost drift. Thoughts?

sara: Thanks Alex. Can you drop the raw metrics here?

alex: sure — TL;DR then numbers: global cache hit rate 44% (vs target 60%), median batch size 3, mean batch size 4.1, p95 batch size 12. p50 latency 110ms, p95 latency 730ms with a 09:00-10:00 spike. error rate 0.42% (up from 0.18%). weekly spend +9% vs previous week. cost per 1k tokens ~ $0.78 (weighted).

mike: Noted. The morning p95 aligns with their daily report-run that hits a lot of small, fresh prompts -> cache miss + tiny batches.

jen: Is prefetch enabled for their session-style flows? If not we should enable a short prefetch window to warm KV for top intents.

alex: Prefetch is on but tuned very conservatively (prefetch_window=30s). If we increase to 120s we should see hit rate uptick for repeated queries during their report window.

ops-bot: Automated anomaly: 2026-02-18 09:12 UTC — spike in token generation p95 latency (+260ms) and error spike (+0.28%). Linked traces: 6.

alex: Quick sample query I used to pull these:
```sql
SELECT
  tenant_id,
  avg(batch_size) AS avg_bs,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p50_lat,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95_lat,
  sum(tokens) AS tokens,
  sum(cost_usd) / (sum(tokens)/1000.0) AS cost_per_1k
FROM inference_requests
WHERE tenant_id = 'acmecorp' AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY tenant_id;
```

sara: Cool — for simplicity I'd split by route. Their onboarding route (route: /generate/onboard) has hit rate 28% vs chatbot route 58%. Onboard route is very latency sensitive.

mike: Proposal: 1) bump prefetch_window to 120s for onboarding route 2) set min_batch_size=2 and max_batch_delay=50ms to allow slightly larger batches without hurting p50 3) enable soft TTL extension for KV on similar embeddings for 5m.

jen: Agree. Also recommend a short canary: run on 10% traffic for 48h. Watch error rate and p95.

alex: Action items: Alex -> schedule canary + config change (10% traffic) by Thurs EOD; Mike -> prepare infra rollback playbook and trace filter; Sara -> reach out to Acme PM with expected impact and ETA. I'll post follow-up metrics snapshot after 48h.

ops-bot: Reminder: canary rollout created: canary/1955551112-acme-prefetch-10pct. Monitor dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/d/ab123/acme-prefetch-canary

alex: One more note: forecasted savings if hit rate goes from 44% -> 62%: ~18% reduction in token cost for this tenant (~$1.8k/month). We'll include that in the renewal notes.

sara: :thumbsup: Sounds good. I'll sync with PM and CS lead.

mike: :eyes: I'll stage the change and share rollback steps in the canary thread.

jen: I'll block time on Thurs for a quick post-canary review.

alex: Thanks team. I'll update thread with 24h snapshot.
